suite: r1097 bounded WebM unknown-size Cluster regression
method: Shipped parser in Node VM; all 291 packaged recordings hash-verified against manifest plus synthetic EBML hierarchy, duration and malformed-input cases. Native browser decode and physical Android capture are separate checks.

results.name: Packaged Ayet-el-Kursi koruma:0 verifies actual bank bytes and passes production inspection
Entire packaged bank classifies 291 hash-verified clips with no header failures
Twenty unknown-sized sibling Clusters remain siblings in unknown and known-sized Segments
Cluster local timestamps reset for every unknown-sized sibling
Known-sized and unknown-sized sibling Clusters may be mixed without nesting
Segment-level Cues, Tags and SeekHead terminate an unknown Cluster at parsed element boundaries
Void and CRC global elements stay inside the current Cluster
Cluster and Segment magic bytes inside a sized Opus packet never create container boundaries
Known-sized Cluster cannot contain another Cluster, whether child length is known or unknown
Recognized masters in invalid parents fail closed instead of becoming nested tracks
Segment or EBML roots inside a Cluster are rejected and never swallowed
Unknown-size scalar, Void and unsupported master are rejected before decode
Truncated sized payload, element ID and size cannot be accepted as an unknown Cluster boundary
Unknown Cluster siblings retain cluster and block timestamp duration checks
Cumulative Opus packet budget still rejects over sixty seconds across sibling Clusters
Twenty-thousand-node bound still rejects a deliberately oversized element list
Source and memory budgets retain published values and reject input without decode
Cancellation during controlled decode settles caller promptly and retains native memory lease
